description.value: Los Sapos Tacos is a Vancouver street-taco specialist focused on authentic Al Pastor and Birria, earning a 4.9-star Google rating. Located in Chinatown on Keefer Street, it operates as both a sit-down restaurant and a ghost kitchen with delivery through major apps. A second location exists in Kitsilano, and the business also offers full-service catering with a personal chef.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is a real, operating Mexican taco restaurant at 210 Keefer Street in Vancouver's Chinatown, open 7 days a week, with a second Kitsilano location also listed. The site explicitly promotes 'Delicious Vegan Tacos Too!' confirming vegan options, and mentions delivery via DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Skip the Dishes plus a 'Catering/Pick-Up ORDERS' section confirming takeout. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag contains a duplicate Saturday entry with conflicting times (Fr-Sa 17:30-03:00 and Sa 18:00-22:00); website version is clearer and should be preferred.
Website lists a second location (Kitsilano, 1780 W3rd, Vancouver BC) not represented in this OSM record — a separate OSM node may or may not exist for it.
Website includes a 'Ghost Kitchen' section, suggesting at least some operations are delivery-only; the physical Keefer Street address is still confirmed as a walk-in location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with confirmed physical address in Vancouver's Chinatown, open 7 days a week, with vegan options and takeout — useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website prominently states 'Delicious Vegan Tacos Too!' and a Google reviewer confirms 'the vegetarian tacos were awesome.'
